messages:
anya (docs): Quick heads-up — found a sneaky snippet mismatch in the v1->v2 migration guide that caused stderr errors in a customer smoke test. We need an urgent patch: update curl + python examples, add note about Content-Type and model_id. Opening PR now.

sam (sdk): Thanks. What broke exactly?

anya (docs): The curl example omitted Content-Type and used "model" instead of "model_id"; some clients got 422s. Repro steps posted in PR.

kai (devex): I'll add a short "troubleshooting" callout to the guide: common 422 fixes, embed-dim mismatch check, and streaming framing note. Also will add i18n tasks — French/Japanese snippets need the same fixes.

sam (sdk): I'll push a tiny compat change to accept both fields for another 2 weeks and add unit tests. Also adding a one-line README snippet showing aliasing: `client.call({ model_id: client.alias('gpt-4-lite') })`.

rahul (eng-oncall): Putting rollback plan on deck in case canary sees errors. Ops command: `./ops/route-switch --to v1-proxy --reason "rollback: migration-snippet-bug"`. I'll watch the canary and post metrics in #release-war-room.

link-bot: FYI — docs PR failed link-check for /examples/old-path. Suggested redirect: /v2/migration-examples.

anya (docs): Action items: I will update PR with corrected curl/python snippets + troubleshooting box. kai -> localize fixes; sam -> compat shim + tests; rahul -> ready rollback. Aim to ship hotfix in next 3 hours and announce in #general. :white_check_mark:
